# Frazik

Frazik is a personal technical brand and AI engineering practice based in Bratislava, Slovakia.
Frazik helps Slovak companies use practical, secure AI and automate meaningful work.

## Services

- Local AI hardware: custom workstations and servers for private local LLM deployments, setup, tuning, monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades.
- AI automation: workflow discovery, secure AI assistants, document and knowledge workflows, integrations, team rollout, and continuous improvement.
